title: Set 191

sentences.ko: 학교에서 현장학습 때문에 보낸 이메일 받았어? 우리 아들은 동의서를 받은 적이 절대 없다는데, 솔직히 걔가 잃어버린 건지 학교에서 깜빡하고 안 보낸 건지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: Did you get that email from the school about the field trip? My son swears they never gave him a permission slip, and I honestly can't tell if he lost it or if they just forgot to send one home.

alts.text: You see the school's email about the field trip? My kid swears he never got a permission slip, and honestly I can't tell if he lost it or they just forgot to send one.

Did you receive the email from the school regarding the field trip? My son insists that he was never given a permission slip, and I honestly cannot tell whether he lost it or whether they simply forgot to send one home.

sentences.note: **swears** 는 정말이라고 우기다, 맹세하다라는 뜻이에요. **permission slip** 은 학교 행사에 보호자가 서명하는 동의서예요.

sentences.ko: 진짜 편하긴 해. 근데 우리 고양이가 왼쪽 팔걸이를 긁어 놔서 그쪽에 긁힌 자국이 좀 있어. 그래도 벽에 붙여 놓으면 전혀 티 안 날 거야.
sentences.text: It's really comfortable, I'll say that, but our cat got to the left arm, so there's some scratching on that side. If you put it up against a wall, though, you'd never even know.

alts.text: Super comfy, I'll give it that, but our cat went after the left arm, so that side's kinda scratched up. Stick it against a wall, though, and you'd never know.
It is very comfortable, I will say that, but our cat damaged the left arm, so there is some scratching on that side. If you place it against a wall, however, you would never notice.

sentences.note: **got to** 는 여기서 무언가를 건드려서 망쳐 놓다라는 뜻이에요. **you'd never even know** 는 전혀 티가 안 난다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 이 스탠딩 책상 괜히 샀나 싶어. 하루 종일 서 있을 줄 알았는데 결국 앉아 있게 되더라. 그래서 이제 그냥 이상한 소리 나는 엄청 비싼 책상이 됐어.
sentences.text: I kind of wish I hadn't bought this standing desk. I thought I'd be standing all day, but I end up sitting anyway, so now it's just a really expensive desk that makes a weird noise.

alts.text: Kinda regret getting this standing desk. Figured I'd stand all day, but I just sit anyway, so now it's a super pricey desk that makes a weird noise.
I somewhat regret purchasing this standing desk. I expected to be standing all day, but I end up sitting regardless, so it is now simply a very expensive desk that makes an unusual noise.

sentences.note: **I kind of wish I hadn't** 는 그러지 말걸 그랬다는 후회를 부드럽게 말하는 표현이에요. **end up** 은 결국 ~하게 되다라는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 음, 색은 너한테 진짜 잘 어울리는데 핏은 잘 모르겠어. 어깨가 좀 헐렁하니까 아직 반품할 수 있으면 한 사이즈 작은 걸로 입어 보는 건 어때?
sentences.text: Okay, I love the color on you, but I'm not sure about the fit. It's kind of loose in the shoulders, so if you can still return it, maybe try a size down?

alts.text: Love the color on you, but the fit's kinda off. It's a little loose in the shoulders, so if you can still return it, maybe go a size down?
I really like the color on you, but I am not certain about the fit. It is somewhat loose in the shoulders, so if you are still able to return it, perhaps you could try a smaller size?

sentences.note: **the color on you** 는 너한테 그 색이 어울린다는 뜻이에요. **a size down** 은 한 치수 작은 것을 말해요.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 장 본 게 드디어 왔는데 절반이 잘못 왔어. 일반 우유 시켰는데 귀리 우유가 왔고, 아보카도 세 개 대신 양파를 세 개 보냈더라. 뭐 양파는 쓰긴 하겠는데 오늘 저녁에 과카몰리 만들려고 했단 말이야.
sentences.text: So the groceries finally showed up, but half the stuff is wrong. Like, I asked for regular milk and got oat milk, and they gave me three onions instead of three avocados. I mean, I'll use the onions, but I was going to make guacamole tonight.

alts.text: Groceries finally came, but like half of it's wrong. I wanted regular milk and got oat milk, and they sent three onions instead of three avocados. I'll use the onions, but I was gonna make guac tonight.

The groceries have finally arrived, but half of the items are incorrect. I ordered regular milk and received oat milk, and they gave me three onions instead of three avocados. I will use the onions, but I had planned to make guacamole this evening.

sentences.note: **showed up** 은 여기서 도착하다라는 뜻이에요. **I was going to** 는 원래 ~하려고 했다는 계획을 말할 때 써요.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

reviewed: 1번 한국어에서 앞은 현장학습, 뒤는 체험학습 동의서라고 해서 말이 어긋났습니다. 그냥 동의서로 바꾸고 아들 말을 옮기는 말투로 다듬었습니다.
2번 한국어의 이건 인정할게는 I'll say that 을 그대로 옮긴 티가 납니다. 진짜 편하긴 해로 바꿨습니다. 고양이가 팔걸이를 건드려서도 got to 의 뜻(긁어서 망쳐 놓음)이 잘 안 살아서 긁어 놔서로 고쳤습니다.
